name: cut
description: Cut a talking head in two calls. Without plan: transcribes clips that have no transcript (the only file it writes beside a clip), cuts silences and fillers, removes only sure retakes, and writes the result as cut-plan.md in the project folder, changing nothing in the project; uncertain cuts stay in and are offered as suggestions. With plan: applies that plan, edited or not, through speech_edit's save (a version first). The language is detected unless you pass it.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: Plan: {project, mode: plan, plan, kept {lines, seconds}, removed {lines {why: n}, fillers, seconds}, suggested?, duration, layers, cut, keep?, next, previous?, transcribed, silence?, note?, warnings?}. Apply: {project, mode: applied, version, duration, undo, layers}. A cut project: {mode: already-cut, ...}.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: plan
params.description: Apply this plan: the path of the plan file in the project folder (cut-plan.md), or the plan's text. Leave out to make a plan.

params.name: language
params.description: The speaker's language code (e.g. es). Leave out (or 'auto') to detect it. Picks the transcription language and the filler set.

params.name: max-pause
params.description: Cap every pause in seconds. Default 0.45, which suits a talking head; 0.5 or more for tutorials.

params.name: recut
params.description: Plan again a project cut already cut. It cuts the current timeline, so takes the first cut removed stay removed.

params.name: detail
params.description: Also answer with the kept lines.

params.name: model
params.description: Whisper model for clips with no transcript.
